item.title: Toorak
item.description: Toorak sits 5km south-east of the CBD in the City of Stonnington, postcode 3142, and it has been Melbourne’s prestige address since the 1850s gold rush money built the first mansions along the ridge above the Yarra. The name itself comes from “Toorak House,” a grand estate that once occupied the land near the corner of Toorak Road and St Georges Road. Today the suburb runs roughly from Orrong Road in the west to Glenferrie Road in the east, with the Yarra River forming the northern boundary and Malvern Road to the south.
